structure: Part 3 read lines 1 to 3418 of src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json in full: the opening of the JSON array and its first 83 country records, from Aruba (record 1, line 2) to Martinique (record 83, ending at line 3418). Each record is one object with id and countryUUID (content, schemeId, schemeAgencyId), ISONumeric, alpha2 and alpha3 (value, listId, listAgencyId, listVersionId), independent, system, systemAlias, systemAlpha2, systemAlpha3, effectiveAlias, effectiveAlpha2, effectiveAlpha3, subDivisions and blocks. Records run in ascending order of their MDM id, so the names are in no alphabetical order. In this slice no record has a subdivision or a system alias, three records (Chad, Oman, Cuba) have no independent key, and 10 records carry two block entries each: an unnamed entry and GBNAG_SPS_EX (Hungary, Latvia, Cyprus, Greece, Czechia, Denmark, Malta, Switzerland, Slovakia, Poland). Claims 001 to 018 are the shapes and rules every record in the slice shares; 019 to 101 are one claim per record, in file order; 102 to 121 are the block memberships, two per blocked record.

claims.statement: The stub serves its country records in ascending order of their MDM id, not in alphabetical order of name: the slice opens with Aruba, Guyana, Reunion and Turkmenistan and ends with Grenada, Bhutan, Guinea-Bissau and Martinique.
claims.note: Inferred from the ids rising through the slice while the names jump around the alphabet. Any alphabetical list a consumer shows must be sorted by the consumer.

claims.statement: Every record's id has schemeId "MDM-COUNTRY" and schemeAgencyId "DEFRA".
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:3-7 (record 1), and the same in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: Every record's id content is the text "gbnag-" followed by the record's countryUUID content.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:4 and 9 (record 1), and the same pairing in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: Every record's countryUUID has schemeId "MDM-COUNTRY" and schemeAgencyId "DEFRA", the same scheme as its id.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:8-12 (record 1), and the same in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: Every record's ISONumeric, alpha2 and alpha3 each carry listId "ISO-3166-3", listAgencyId "ISO" and listVersionId "2024-06".
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:13-30 (record 1), and the same in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: ISONumeric is a string with no leading zeros, so a code below 100 is one or two digits: Armenia is "51", Bahrain "48", American Samoa "16", Angola "24" and Bhutan "64".
claims.note: A consumer that matches or shows the three-digit ISO numeric form has to pad these itself.

claims.statement: Every record in the slice has system "gbnag".
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:32 (record 1), and the same in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: No record in the slice has a system alias: systemAlias, systemAlpha2 and systemAlpha3 are null in all 83.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:33-35 (record 1), and the same in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: In every record of the slice, effectiveAlpha2 and effectiveAlpha3 are the same as the ISO alpha2 and alpha3 values.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:20, 26, 37-38 (record 1), and the same in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: No record in the slice carries a subdivision: subDivisions is an empty list in all 83.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:39 (record 1), and the same in all 83 records of the slice

claims.statement: independent is false in 80 of the 83 records, and the records for Chad, Oman and Cuba have no independent key at all.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:31 (record 1); Chad at 2492-2530, Oman at 2791-2829, Cuba at 3050-3088

claims.statement: independent does not say whether a country is sovereign: it is false for sovereign states such as Japan, Canada and the United States as well as for territories such as Aruba and Greenland.
claims.note: Inferred because the same false value sits on every record that has the key, whatever its status, so nothing in the slice can tell a country from a territory.

claims.statement: The list served as countries includes territories, dependencies and Crown Dependencies alongside states, among them Aruba, Reunion, American Samoa, Greenland, Jersey, the Isle of Man, the British Indian Ocean Territory, the Cocos (Keeling) Islands, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Sint Maarten, the Aland Islands, Guadeloupe, Martinique and the United States Minor Outlying Islands.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:36 (Aruba), 686 (Jersey), 3004 (Isle of Man), 646 (British Indian Ocean Territory (the)), 3213 (United States Minor Outlying Islands (the))

claims.statement: effectiveAlias names follow the ISO 3166 short-name style, with the definite article in brackets after the name: "Niger (the)", "Cook Islands (the)", "Turks and Caicos Islands (the)", "United States of America (the)", "Marshall Islands (the)" and "Syrian Arab Republic (the)".

Other effectiveAlias names use the ISO long-form qualifiers in brackets or after a comma: "Moldova (the Republic of)", "Bolivia (Plurinational State of)", "Korea (the Democratic People's Republic of)", "Palestine, State of", "Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha", "Virgin Islands (British)" and "Sint Maarten (Dutch part)".
effectiveAlias names are written without diacritics: "Reunion", "Saint Barthelemy" and "Aland Islands".

10 of the 83 records carry block entries, two each: Hungary, Latvia, Cyprus, Greece, Czechia, Denmark, Malta, Switzerland, Slovakia and Poland. The other 73 have an empty blocks list. No block entry in the slice has a tag, and every entry has includeCountry true.
claims.note: Switzerland is in the GBNAG_SPS_EX block with the nine EU members of the slice. What the block means is not stated in this file.

claims.statement: The slice does not say what the GBNAG_SPS_EX block stands for or which block the unnamed first entry of each blocked record belongs to.
claims.ref: src/main/resources/responses/countriesResponse.json:440-450 (Hungary's blocks, the first in the slice); looked through every block entry in lines 1 to 3418
claims.note: The block name is a code only, and the unnamed entry has no name key. How the stub filters on the blocks parameter belongs to the countries endpoint part.
